posts.title: You don't need Jev for good emoji search
posts.description: An interactive emoji search demo runs here in the web version of this post. There's been a lot of Jev hype lately, and for good reason. posts.title: Running Wayland, X11, GNOME, and KDE natively on an iPad
posts.description: I like running software on devices that aren't "supposed" to run it. I own the hardware. I should control the software.
